question: ________ is an indication of the total borrowings needed by the government.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fiscal deficit.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fiscal deficit** is the** difference** between the government's** total expenditure** and its **total revenue**.

 
 
• It indicates the **amount of borrowing** needed by the government to meet its expenses.
 
• A** high fiscal deficit **can lead to **inflation** and a **decrease** in the **value** of the country's currency.
